E3 point: no Parfum declared, first listed preservative Benzyl Alcohol (8), so 1-7 prominent; Coco-Glucoside (11) is non-prominent and not counted.

focusPrimary.rationale: Dominant claims are anti-dandruff, scalp irritation and oiliness. Dandruff positioning without Piroctone Olamine/Climbazole is not formula-compatible with scalp_active (7.2); irritation wording sits inside dandruff units and SC1 fails, so scalp_active via comfort is out; oily/sebum wording is absorbed by the dandruff units (E2a: never creates an oily claim), so no clarifying claim remains. No lengths-care claim. -> general.
focusPrimary.counterSignal: If the absorbed sebum wording were read as oily positioning, the formula is F6-compatible (moderate cleansing, low conditioning, low weight) and clarifying would follow.
